title: Microloop experiment annotator — ting
content:
Purpose:
Quick personal tracker for microloop experiments — compact rows for fast capture when I run on laptop/GPU node. Not intended as canonical experiment DB; migrate useful rows to run-db later.

Notes: 
- Shortcuts: q=quantized (4-bit/8-bit), c=cache-enabled, n=no-cache, b=batch size.
- Goal: capture p50/p90, token units, and quick cost estimate to decide if config is worth promoting.
- Keep entries minimal: RunID, Model, SeqLen, Batch, Tokens, Avg(ms), p90(ms), Throughput(tok/s), Units($), Key flags, short notes.

Table (pipe-separated):
RunID | ModelVariant | SeqLen | Batch | Tokens | Avg_ms | p90_ms | Tok/s | Units($) | Flags | Notes
R001 | mix-7b-v1 | 64 | 8 | 12,800 | 35.4 | 70.2 | 360 | 0.009 | q,c | baseline microloop (gpu:A10G)
R002 | mix-7b-v1 | 256 | 4 | 64,000 | 78.1 | 160.7 | 820 | 0.022 | q,c | long context — p90 spike at cache miss
R003 | mix-7b-v1 | 256 | 4 | 64,000 | 91.6 | 210.3 | 700 | 0.022 | q,n | same model w/out KV cache — throughput -> down 15%
R004 | opt-13b-v2 | 128 | 2 | 32,000 | 140.2 | 320.4 | 230 | 0.055 | n | initial try, high variance
R005 | mix-7b-v1 | 64 | 16 | 25,600 | 28.7 | 60.3 | 560 | 0.018 | q,c,big | batching bump reduces avg but p90 similar

Quick derivations / formulas I use:
- Tok/s ~= (Batch * SeqLen) / (Avg_ms / 1000)
- Units($) rough = (Tok/s * runtime_hours * unit_cost_per_tok). For ad-hoc: unit_cost_per_tok=~1e-6 for q models on A10G (back-of-envelope).
- p90 spikes often align with cache eviction / first token after prefix change — annotate with 'cache-hit%' next time.

Immediate TODOs:
- [ ] Add column for cache_hit_ratio (capture from trace)
- [ ] Run R002 with preloaded prefix to validate spike source
- [ ] Try mixed-precision fallback (8->4) to compare quality+latency

Unresolved/ideas:
- See weird p90 jump in R004 — maybe memory pressure on node; correlate with dmesg and nvidia-smi logs.
- Try a low-latency preset (single-stream, no batching) to get tail numbers for SLO.

Quick run checklist (when I spin a node):
- git checkout pr/1428 (runtime perf fixes)
- export RUN_TAG=ting-microloop-YYYYMMDD
- enable KV_DEBUG=1 if testing cache-hit
- record last_modified_git=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) into notes

Short change-log:
2025-11-03: initial sheet scaffold and 5 runs from laptop A10G.
2025-11-07: added R005 (higher batch), noted throughput delta and reduced avg.
2025-11-09: decided to collect cache_hit_ratio next session; added TODOs.

Slack refs: ping @maya for help with dmesg parse, @ravi for config tuning.

If promoting a row to run-db, include: full node spec, exact docker image, seed, prompt, and raw perf traces.

End of sheet.
